_about: SHELF of Persian poetry and Sufi prose in English before 1931, by translators with no shelf of their own: H. Wilberforce Clarke (Nizami's Sikandar Nama, the Divan of Hafiz, Sa'di's Bustan, Suhrawardi's Awarif), James Atkinson (Nizami's Laili and Majnun, 1836), C. E. Wilson (Nizami's Haft Paikar, Rumi's Masnavi Book II) and Richard Le Gallienne's free Hafiz. Whinfield, Nicholson, FitzGerald, Gertrude Bell and the Wisdom of the East volumes are on their own shelves. Each title gates on its own translator. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-17 by lane C (round 80); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
_name_words_note: Translator names only: fetch_shelf.py treats them as the identity check. Bare 'wilson' and 'atkinson' are left out: both are common surnames other shelves also claim.
_surname_note: Per title: the translator's name forms.

persian-poets-masnavi-book-2.work: The Masnavi, Book II, vol. I: translation

persian-poets-hafiz-odes-le-gallienne.note: A free verse rendering made from Clarke's and Payne's literal versions, as Le Gallienne's preface says; not a translation from the Persian.

_excluded.laili-1968-reprint: lailimajnunpoem0000jame is a 1968 reprint of Atkinson's Laili and Majnun; the 1836 Valpy scan is used.
_excluded.awarif-1979: bwb_S0-AVT-190 is a 1979 Lahore printing of Clarke's Awarif; the 1891 Calcutta scan is used.
_excluded.haft-paikar-commentary: Vol. II of Wilson's Haft Paikar (1924) is his commentary, not the translation.
_excluded.masnavi-commentary: Vol. II of Wilson's Masnavi Book II (1910) is his commentary, not the translation.

pers-bustan-clarke.author: The title page OCR reads 'CAPTAIN H. WILBERTORCE CLARKE, R.E.' for H. Wilberforce Clarke, with W. H. Allen's London 1879 imprint. Checked by eye 2026-10-17.
